review: Post-handoff independent AI confirmation of five verb-paradigm fixes

confirmed.result: The citation forms and Form II pattern are correct. The revised note correctly distinguishes the assimilation of the final root nun before the subject suffix at 18:84:2 and before nun al-wiqayah at 18:95:3 from the unassimilated root nun before emphatic nun in 24:55:16. The QAC stem label omits the final root nun because of segmentation; it must not become the learner's dictionary lemma.

The sound-root classification, nasara vowel class and citation forms are correct. The revised note covers both the suspended interrogative-clause object at 18:19:27 and the direct noun object with the sense of waiting at 36:49:2. The Quranic imperfect vowels support the selected class. The QAC lemma's leading shadda is not a citation-form root doubling.

The passive perfect and imperfect forms and their pattern are correct. The revised note now permits a prepositional phrase in the syntactic position of deputy subject, matching the QAC analysis at 55:41. It no longer requires an overt nominative noun in this occurrence.

The hollow-waw Form IV citation forms and weak-letter account are correct. The stated jussive analysis of 18:20:7 follows its coordination with the conditional answer at 18:20:5. Both occurrence corrections are present in meta/overrides.json. A direct count of QAC's verb rows confirms the evidence field's 16 Quran-wide imperfect occurrences.

The daraba vowel class follows the kasra imperfect attested at 23:43:2. The revised note correctly includes both the transitive construction at 23:43 and the intransitive decree construction at 23:27. The latter's subject is 23:27:24, with no direct object. The lexical-variability caution is now consistent with the cross-reference in nasolaxu|I|ACT.

sourceCautions.issue: The raw metadata, QAC segments, generated English morphology and word-level Arabic irab retain the Corpus subjunctive classification. The packet builder deliberately preserves those raw references while correcting verb.mood and adding qacCorrection. This is expected source provenance, not a remaining library error.
sourceCautions.requiredAction: Rebuild packets before authoring; reviewers must follow the adjudicated jussive correction and require an audit note. Do not infer that agreement between the QAC file and its fork independently confirms the incorrect mood.

sourceCautions.issue: Raw source lemma labels can be truncated, carry recitation assimilation, or use an inflected form. All three selected library entries correctly supply canonical citation forms.
sourceCautions.requiredAction: Chunk authors should use the verified paradigm citation form and record source disagreements rather than copy lemmaQac mechanically.

validation.result: All five batches passed with zero errors and zero warnings.

limits: This is an independent AI confirmation of the five named post-confirmation edits, not a fresh semantic review of all 358 paradigms.

QAC grammar pages were checked against the cached source copies and current web responses where available. The direct word-page fetches for 23:27:24 and 24:55:14 were unavailable; the local complete QAC source was used, and the emphatic occurrence is correctly indexed at 24:55:16.

The lexical-variability statements for sabaqa were checked for consistency with the existing library review record and Quranic vowels; no new independent inspection of the cited printed lexica was completed.
Mechanical validation and AI confirmation do not constitute scholarly approval. All new lessons remain withheld from live publication pending scholarly review.
